headline: $113 a month toward your goals, starting with travel
sproutSays: Your travel goal is $118 a month away, and your guilt-free money can turn up that dial. $113 a month covers one month of costs in 3 months and fills your safety cushion in 14.

bankerSummary: College student, not yet an FNB customer, no steady income. Income: $3,000 one-time summer savings, $2,000 per semester aid refund, $300/mo family support = about $1,133/mo effective. Fixed costs $650, debt payments $0 (57% of income), surplus $483/mo, savings $400, credit range: building. Spending plan: $226/mo savings, $257/mo guilt-free. Goals: travel ($2,500 in 12 months, P1, $91/mo of $209/mo needed); credit building (habit, P2); first home ($15,000 est. in 84 months, P3, $22/mo of $179/mo needed). Plan: now FNB Student Checking, Credit Center (credit score and report), CardGuard debit card controls and Spend Insights, Mortgage calculators, Financial Insights Learning Center, FNB $15,000 Student Scholarship Sweepstakes, FirstRate Savings; next Savers Goal CD; later FNB SmartSecured Credit Card, FNB Home Ownership Program.
